name: What are the benefits of converting a garage into a rental unit?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of converting a garage into a rental unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a garage into a rental unit offers several benefits. The primary advantage is generating passive rental income, which can significantly offset mortgage payments or improve financial stability. It also adds value to your property and provides flexible living space that can be used for family, guests, or a home office if not rented. Compared to new construction, conversions often utilize existing structures, potentially reducing overall costs and construction time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include generating rental income, increasing property value, and creating flexible living space, often at a lower cost than new construction.
